messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] eval-gate ALERT: prompt-eval-regression detected for model redwood/open-7b@v3
incident-bot: Gate=Safety+Toxicity, observed=0.39 (threshold=0.22), window=3m, failing_prompts=27, endpoints=[/chat/generate,/api/v1/respond]
pagerduty: Pager P-59312 created and paging -> Priya (oncall)
Priya: acked — starting triage. Which deploy changed and when? any canary logs?
Mia (ml-evals): canary to open-7b@v3 rolled at 2026-05-10T02:17Z, trafficSplit v3=70% v2=30. Our eval-run flagged both toxicity and safety policy hits up vs baseline.
Raj (infra): infra health ok, no GPU OOMs. Noticed sanitizer service returning a few 502s when content sanitizer attempted to strip tokens -> upstream retries.
Priya: any customer reports yet?
Tom (support): Support case from VelocityShop (VS-1023): "explicit language in generated product taglines". I'm drafting mitigation comms.
Mia (ml-evals): hypothesis: sampling default changed in v3 + small tokenizer normalization change. Causes more merged subtoken sequences that trigger safety heuristics on a subset of prompts. Eval gate thresholds are global — making this noisy on per-model shifts.
Priya: immediate plan: 1) reduce default to v2 (pin) 2) mute eval-gate pages briefly to avoid paging storm while we verify 3) apply sticky routing for high-risk tenants 4) capture failing examples into EI-2101
Raj: I can add tenant sticky routing; which tenants should we prioritize?
Tom: VelocityShop and BetaPartners are reporting or flagged; route them to v2. Also push a temporary firebreak for public demo tenants.
Priya: executing rollback now: `redwoodctl models set-default model=redwood/open-7b@v2 --reason="safety regression v3"`
system: command executed by Priya at 1912349123 -> model default -> redwood/open-7b@v2
incident-bot: Detected default-model change -> redwood/open-7b@v2 (actor=Priya) — monitoring eval-gate
Mia: running a targeted eval sweep on the failing corpus (approx 1.2k prompts), quick subset finished: toxicity back to baseline when pinned to v2. Full sweep ETA ~7m. Logging failing prompts to EI-2101.
Priya: muting eval-gate pages for 12m to avoid duplicates during validation. Annotating incident with rollback reason.
pagerduty: P-59312 acknowledged by Priya at 1912349126
Raj: sticky routing applied for tenants [VelocityShop, BetaPartners, DemoTeam] -> v2 at 1912349140
Olivia (sre): recommend adding a short-lived sanitizer backoff policy to prevent retries amplifying impact (50ms exponential, max 3 retries) and a soft rate-limit on /api/v1/respond to slow customer retries.
Priya: Raj can you apply soft rate-limit (60r/s) on /api/v1/respond for 10m?
Raj: rate-limit applied at 1912349152 (60r/s burst 100)
Mia: full sweep complete: gate passing on regression set pinned to v2. Created EI-2101 with artifacts and diff logs. Noting model-diff: tokenizer merge behavior changed at tokenizer v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0 and sampler default temp 0.7->0.8.
Tom: updated VelocityShop ticket VS-1023 with mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem. Customer notified that exposure reduced and we will follow up with a detailed writeup.
Priya: assigning owners: Mia -> eval-gate hardening + per-model baselines; Raj -> routing tooling + rate-limit automation; Olivia -> sanitizer retry policies; Tom -> customer comms and support follow-ups; Sara -> deploy pipeline check to ensure pre-deploy eval thresholds are enforced per model.
Sara: I'll add a mandatory per-model eval baseline check in the deploy pipeline and a rollback safety switch. ETA EOD.
Priya: current status: rollback complete, targeted tenants pinned to v2, sanitizer rate-limit applied, eval-gate muted for 12m, full sweep passed. Oncall handoff planned in 40m to Raj for monitoring & follow-ups.
Raj: taking over oncall after Priya. Dashboards set to 30s refresh and eval-watch alerting enabled. Will unmute pages only after 20m steady state post-unmute.
incident-bot: eval-gate unmute scheduled at 1912349832 (12m)
Mia: opened EI-2101 with failing prompts, PR with added targeted tests, and a reproducer notebook. Link to artifacts: https://internal.redwood/eval/EI-2101
Tom: created support follow-up case VS-1023-FU and added escalation notes for legal if required.
Priya: thanks team. Please add any missed items here. We will run a short blameless retro and include timeline, root cause (tokenizer + sampler change), and decision to rollback. Closing pager P-59312 after 30m steady state post-unmute.
Olivia: I'll draft the incident blameless postmortem and include mitigation playbook for future model swaps.
Priya: :thumbsup: good work, everyone.
